name: dsh-panel-pins
description: Sidebar panel management: a Panels launcher that collects global panel rows AND third-party plugin entry rows into one grouped menu (original-button click, per-group fold toggles, badge counts both), persisted pin/unpin menu items, a scrollable panel list, and a toggleable compact-footer layout patch at 15vh (ported from @weibaohui/dsh-sidebar-tidy; bottom entries stay in place, never folded into the menu).
